abi_observations: The100-byte wrapper preserves its caller-provided output storage from X8.
The first stage receives the original two input pointers and writes a three-pointer temporary into local storage via X8.
The second stage receives the temporary by address and writes the final libc++-layout string into the preserved caller output storage.
Temporary pointer storage is released through standard operator delete; input runtime data values are not read or exported.

official_references.review: Base64 BIO filter, memory BIO use and BIO_FLAGS_BASE64_NO_NL documented.
Exact method IDs0x20b/0x401, no-newline flag0x100, flush11 and buffer-pointer control115 match observed metadata and wrapper controls.

limits: The reference version is not an identification of the original binary OpenSSL version.
Base64 only identifies the outer encoding. It does not establish whether the preceding bytes are encrypted payload, MAC framing or another native encoding.
No independent cryptography, guessed decoding, hardcoded private key, native presign hook ABI or working offline request is introduced.
